newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain parliament rejects motions against 97 budget.
newsitem.headline: Spain parliament rejects motions against 97 budget.

text.p: The Spanish parliament rejected opposition motions against the crucial 1997 budget on Wednesday by 176 votes to 161.

The wholesale amendments put forward by the main opposition Socialists and the Communist-led United Left were voted out on the second day of debate on the draft budget, which is key to Spain's hopes of meeting the criteria to join a single currency.

The budget is assured safe passage when the final vote is taken on November 22 on the combined votes of the ruling Popular Party and those of its allies in Catalonia, the Basque Country and the Canary Islands.
